description: This file defines an Express router for analytics endpoints in a web application backend. It includes route handlers for cost analysis, active user trend, and new user over time, protected by authentication and tenant verification middleware.

methods.name: HEAD /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Health check endpoint that responds with headers indicating the service is reachable.

methods.name: OPTIONS /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Preflight OPTIONS request handler for the llm-cost-by-agent endpoint.

methods.name: Middleware for tenant scope check
methods.description: Middleware that inspects request headers and query parameters to determine tenant scope, and potentially bypass tenant restrictions.

methods.name: GET /llm-cost-by-agent
methods.description: Endpoint to get language model cost metrics by agent, protected by auth and tenant verification.

methods.name: GET /llm-costs/over-time
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve cost over time data, protected by auth and tenant verification.

methods.name: GET /users/active-trend
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve user activity trend data, normalizing query parameters.

methods.name: GET /users/new-over-time
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve data on new users over time, protected by auth and tenant verification.
